label: YWHAE::NUTM2B

sections.text: YWHAE encodes the phosphoprotein-binding adaptor 14-3-3 epsilon.
NUTM2B encodes a NUT-family protein whose normal function remains incompletely characterized.

The fusion joins YWHAE to a NUTM2-family partner, producing an abnormal transcription-associated protein. It defines a major high-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma group, often with a high-grade round-cell component and strong cyclin D1/BCOR expression.
